contract.duplicate_registration_idempotency: Registering the same callback multiple times for the same plugin/event does not create duplicate listeners
contract.single_registry_entry: Repeated registration of the same callback leaves exactly one listener entry
contract.unregister_effect: unregister() removes the existing listener completely
contract.post_unregister_delivery: A callback removed by unregister() receives no subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Duplicate registration followed by unregister leaves the listener registry structurally consistent
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration and unregister operation continues to require the events permission
